architecture: StripNet2 (stripnet2-nolat) + central colour pool (ColourPool center) + identity-initialised 64-channel 3x3 residual block at 8x16 (capacity large, codex/capacity1025)

input.name: strip_ycbcr
input.strip: profile_scanner.strip_geometry + sample (4.5-20 m, 128 metric columns over +-1.0 m), uint8, rows INTER_AREA (INTER_LINEAR if <128) resized to 128, far rows first; RIGHT strip flipped left/right (mirror_right)

mapping: logits; 4-type head, no unknown class: max(P(dashed)+P(dbl_near), P(solid)+P(dbl_far)) < 0.9 -> no inference this frame (abstains, paused like lane_prob_dip; strip_model.HOLD_BY_FAMILY, DaBin 10-26 filterab1026 F4); P(dashed) = dashed + dbl_near (dbl_near = ego-side line of a double marking dashed -> dashed, dbl_far -> solid); P(yellow) = colour softmax yellow, blue shown white; yellow + dashed passed through (strip_model.StripModel.decide4). The only StripNet model; it gives both heads.
